# Luke's Mixes

> A DJ mix archive: 47 mixes spanning September 2018 to May 2026, streamed
> free with AI-generated liner notes tracking recurring artists, energy
> arcs, and the seven-year story between the records.

## Pages

- [Home](https://luke-dj-mixes.pages.dev/): latest mix + the crate carousel + full archive by year
- [Collection](https://luke-dj-mixes.pages.dev/collection): grid view of every mix
- [About](https://luke-dj-mixes.pages.dev/about): what this archive is
- [Podcast feed](https://luke-dj-mixes.pages.dev/feed.xml): RSS with audio enclosures

## Notes

- Each mix page (/mix/mix-NN-month-year/) carries a full tracklist with
  timestamps, BPM/key/energy data, genre breakdown, and liner notes.
- Audio streams from Cloudflare R2; pages are static (Astro).
